#!/bin/bash
set -e

W="/tmp/bench77602468"
IMG="private-gcr.invalid/bench77602468/app:1.0"
CONF="/var/lib/bench77602468/crio/crio.conf"

# where CRI-O keeps its images: the graph root, run root and driver of its configuration (a copy anywhere else is invisible to it)
conf() { awk -F'"' -v k="$1" '$1 ~ "^"k"[[:space:]]*=" {print $2; exit}' "$CONF"; }
ROOT=$(conf root); RUNROOT=$(conf runroot); DRIVER=$(conf storage_driver)
echo "[solution] CRI-O's storage: root $ROOT, run root $RUNROOT, driver $DRIVER"

echo "[solution] saving the image from Docker's store, and copying the archive into CRI-O's storage (same name)..."
T=$(mktemp -d)
"$W/bin/docker" save -o "$T/image.tar" "$IMG"
sudo skopeo copy "docker-archive:$T/image.tar" "containers-storage:[$DRIVER@$ROOT+$RUNROOT]$IMG"
rm -rf "$T"

echo "[solution] CRI-O sees it:"
"$W/bin/node-crictl" inspecti "$IMG" | grep -E '"id"|repoTags' | head -3

#!/bin/bash
# docker save, then a skopeo `dir:` copy (the manifest and config kept as they are), then CRI-O's storage
set -e
W=/tmp/bench77602468
IMG=private-gcr.invalid/bench77602468/app:1.0
CONF=/var/lib/bench77602468/crio/crio.conf
conf() { awk -F'"' -v k="$1" '$1 ~ "^"k"[[:space:]]*=" {print $2; exit}' $CONF; }
ROOT=$(conf root); RUNROOT=$(conf runroot)
DEST="containers-storage:[overlay@$ROOT+$RUNROOT]"
T=$(mktemp -d)
$W/bin/docker save -o $T/image.tar $IMG
sudo skopeo copy docker-archive:$T/image.tar dir:$T/dir
sudo skopeo copy dir:$T/dir "$DEST$IMG"
sudo rm -rf $T

#!/bin/bash
# a storage.conf with CRI-O's graph root and run root, given to skopeo through CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF, so the destination needs no bracket syntax
set -e
W=/tmp/bench77602468
IMG=private-gcr.invalid/bench77602468/app:1.0
CONF=/var/lib/bench77602468/crio/crio.conf
conf() { awk -F'"' -v k="$1" '$1 ~ "^"k"[[:space:]]*=" {print $2; exit}' $CONF; }
ROOT=$(conf root); RUNROOT=$(conf runroot)
DEST="containers-storage:[overlay@$ROOT+$RUNROOT]"
T=$(mktemp -d)
$W/bin/docker save -o $T/image.tar $IMG
printf '[storage]\ndriver = "overlay"\ngraphroot = "%s"\nrunroot = "%s"\n' "$ROOT" "$RUNROOT" > $T/storage.conf
sudo env CONTAINERS_STORAGE_CONF=$T/storage.conf skopeo copy docker-archive:$T/image.tar containers-storage:$IMG
rm -rf $T

#!/bin/bash
# the program is taken out of the image and a new image is built with the same name: a different image id, not the Docker image
set -e
W=/tmp/bench77602468
IMG=private-gcr.invalid/bench77602468/app:1.0
CONF=/var/lib/bench77602468/crio/crio.conf
conf() { awk -F'"' -v k="$1" '$1 ~ "^"k"[[:space:]]*=" {print $2; exit}' $CONF; }
ROOT=$(conf root); RUNROOT=$(conf runroot)
DEST="containers-storage:[overlay@$ROOT+$RUNROOT]"
T=$(mktemp -d)
C=$($W/bin/docker create $IMG)
$W/bin/docker cp $C:/app $T/app
$W/bin/docker rm $C >/dev/null
printf 'FROM scratch\nCOPY app /app\nENTRYPOINT ["/app"]\n' > $T/Dockerfile
$W/bin/docker build -q -t rebuilt-bench77602468:1 $T >/dev/null
$W/bin/docker save -o $T/rebuilt.tar rebuilt-bench77602468:1
sudo skopeo copy docker-archive:$T/rebuilt.tar "$DEST$IMG"
rm -rf $T
